arguments.description: optional object — arguments for that tool, sent first and as given; default: {}, then the example the server publishes for the tool, then arguments built from its inputSchema.

line.description: Optional. A line credential, for a client that cannot send the x-line header or _meta["zeam-pass/line"]: the call runs on that line's time.

probe.description: optional int — how many tools to try when `tool` is omitted; default 5.

tool.description: optional string — the tool to call unpaid; default: the first tool that answers an unpaid call with x402 terms, trying the tools the server prices first, then the unpriced ones in tools/list order (at most `probe` tools are tried).

url.description: string — the MCP endpoint, absolute http(s) URL, e.g. https://host/mcp. Private and internal names and addresses are refused.
